snippet.title: Leg It: Don't Stop
snippet.description:
LEG IT: DON’T STOP launches on Steam on 13 October 2026!
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5190210/Leg_It_Dont_Stop/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=steam_launch
Survive an endless onslaught of enemies, take down powerful elemental bosses and unlock new ways to play.
⚔️ 32 unique arenas
⚔️ 35 character sets
⚔️ Mix & match characters and arenas
⚔️ Unlockable content
⚔️ Steam Achievements
⚔️ Keyboard & controller support
LEG IT: DON’T STOP — Coming 13 October 2026.
#LegItDontStop #IndieGame #Steam #IndieDev #PCGaming
